Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to retrieve the complete top 10 list for the domestic box office. In Step 4, after clicking the 'Domestic' link, the agent provided a screenshot and OCR text that only contained 19 movies, none of which were ranked 1 through 10. The list started at rank 3 and ended at rank 93, completely missing the top 10 entries (which would be ranks 1-10). The agent did not scroll down the page to capture the top-ranked movies, leading to an incomplete dataset that the Assistant later used to generate an incorrect answer.
